The original sources provide conflicting claims about the artist of the album "Welcome to My World":

- **Dean Martin** is cited in documents D1S1, D2S1, and D3S1 as the artist of the 1967 studio album "Welcome to My World".
- **Frank Sinatra** is cited in D5S1 as the artist of the same-named 1967 album.
- **Elvis Presley** is cited in D6S1 as the artist of a 1977 compilation album titled "Welcome to My World".

Each claim refers to a distinct album with the same title and different artists. Therefore, all three answers are valid and distinct based on the provided context.
